description.text: The "Homoiossaron" (archive ID: AGL371) is capable of mimicking human forms or parts thereof. Some of these rare and dangerous entities are capable of channeling the Æther itself.
This enemy has powerful slam attacks but rotates slowly during casting. This is the best time to go behind it and attack.
The enemy can reassemble its body in various forms and move quickly across the battlefield.
The enemy will attempt to trap the operators! Quick interruption will counter it.
